claim: There is no city siege map reachable from the front end on this PC. FrontEnd.EnumerateBattleMaps lists for "siege" (false and true alike) 7 forts only: rti_fort_9 Lorraine, western_artillery_fort Prussian Stone Fort, ottoman_artillery_fort, ottoman_great_fortress, rti_fort_2 Conde sur l'Escaut, rti_fort_1 El Arish, rti_fort_3 Retranchement. The types "classic" (16 maps, 25 with true: the extra nine are NMPB_ historical-map copies and Tabuk Mesa), "naval" (3), "historic" (0 / 15 NHMPB_), and the names "historical", "settlement", "land", "city" (0 each) have no map flagged IsSiege other than the 7 forts, and EnumerateNapoleonsBattleMaps (12 NHB_ field/naval battles) has none. A settlement battle needs a campaign (pre-battle popup of a besieged settlement), which the harness cannot stage without a played campaign save: no siege_city row. The siege_small fort remains the only siege scenario
